Bihar Monsoon Active Due to Bay of Bengal Low Pressure

Monsoon activity has increased in Bihar due to a low-pressure system in the Bay of Bengal. This has led to active monsoon conditions across the state. Authorities have issued warnings for heavy rainfall in three districts.
